title: The same model, with The Nice Guys turned down for good
construction_note: m6-01's model, plus a standing not-ever for The Nice Guys (2016) — what 'stop suggesting it' leaves behind. A recommendation for something funny must not offer it as the lead or as a direction, and must not bring the refusal up.

genres.name: Buddy Crime
genres.instruction: Mismatched partners on a case. Violence is allowed, cruelty isn't.

genres.name: Banter
genres.instruction: People who talk fast and funny under pressure. I like dialogue that does the work.

genres.name: Heist Comedy
genres.instruction: Capers where the plan is the joke. Light on stakes, heavy on charm.

vibes.name: Two Idiots, One Case
vibes.instruction: Two people who should not be partners, a case that keeps getting worse, and jokes that never let the danger off the hook.

vibes.name: Plan Goes Sideways
vibes.instruction: A plan that was never going to work, and people talking their way through it falling apart.
